description: Defines the Polymer.IronSelection class for managing item selection states, including methods for getting, setting, toggling, and clearing selections.

classes.name: Polymer.IronSelection
classes.description: A class for managing selection state of items, supporting single and multiple selection modes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the currently selected item(s), either as a single item or an array depending on the 'multi' property.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all selections except those specified in the 'excludes' array.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Checks if a given item is currently selected.

methods.name: setItemSelected
methods.description: Sets the selection state for a specific item, optionally invoking a callback.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Selects an item; toggles if 'multi' mode is enabled.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the selection state of an item.
